RED/GREEN mutation transcript (all mutants seeded in src, run, reverted; git status clean after each):

- Mutant A (the 02c4 AC#2 mutation — unconditional updated_at stamp in BindingLifecycle.clear_absent): test_out_of_window_alive_pass_reaches_clear_absent_with_no_churn FAILED — 'clear_absent on an entry with NO absence counter must not stamp updated_at (change gate): 2026-08-22T08:18:31Z -> 2099-01-01T00:00:00Z' (the frozen sentinel appeared; byte-compare alone is blind to this — the updated_at oracle is the RED-driver).
- Mutant B (reach regression — dropped the _best_effort(binding_store, 'clear_absent', …) call in outbound_mutation_builders.py): same test FAILED — 'must reach clear_absent exactly once for DIG-1, got: []' (the spy is the reach guard the 02c4 oracle lacked).
- Mutant C (clear_absent no longer resets the counter): test_out_of_window_404_then_alive_roundtrip_clears_absence FAILED — 'must reset the absence counter (clear_absent TRUE branch), got … absent_404_count: 1'.

GREEN (unmutated): all 5 tests in test_reconcile_idempotency.py pass (3 pre-existing unmodified + 2 new). Harness: out_of_window/deleted sets on the fake (window-JQL filtering; direct GET 404s for deleted, matching live Jira), reconcile_run_differs pre-registered so wire_backend monkeypatches _load_reconcile_backend -> JiraBackend(fake transport) (real adapter + mappers, fake transport only — the 02c4 RCA path (b)). note_absent_or_rekey degrades to note_absent as designed (no captured jira_id on these bindings). Gates: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (629 files), complexity new=0 increased=0. No src/rebar file modified.
